label: Kodak Portra 400
source: Kodak Alaris technical data E-4050 (February 2016, revised 2-16), curves read from the PDF's vector paths (page 4); Print Grain Index from page 3

spectral_sensitivity.unit: log10 sensitivity (reciprocal exposure, erg/cm2, for density 0.2 above D-min)

print_grain_index.note: Kodak Print Grain Index (diffuse printing, 14 in viewing distance); RMS granularity not published

notes: Approximate digitization; not supplied or endorsed by Kodak Alaris / Eastman Kodak Company. Sensitometry x = (log H - Log H Ref) / log10(2), Log H Ref -1.44 lux-seconds read from the characteristic-curve chart; density is Status M including base, made monotone by running maximum. Spectral sensitivity kept only where the curve is drawn above the chart floor (0.0); wavelengths where a curve leaves the chart are omitted, so a channel's wavelength list can be non-contiguous. Individual dye curves not published; dye_density holds only the published midscale neutral and minimum density curves. Characteristic curves: Exposure Daylight, Status M, Log H Ref -1.44 (no process line). Spectral sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/50 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min. Spectral dye density: typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no process line). Chart artwork codes printed on the page are E4040C and E4040P. Print Grain Index table as published: 'less than 25' entries are kept as that text (25 is the visual threshold), no print sizes in cm are published. The MTF chart (Exposure Daylight, Process C-41) is not digitized.

scan.note: fitted to 98 Lomography community scans (lomography.com/films/871910984-kodak-portra-400/photos, recent, pages 1-2, 2026-11-11); colours of real scans, not manufacturer data
